description: List all calendars owned by or shared with the user
examples: Show me my calendars
List all my calendars
What calendars do I have?
Show shared calendars
notes: Returns both owned and shared calendars. The isDefaultCalendar property identifies the user's primary calendar. Shared calendars have canEdit=false unless the user has write access.

description: Get a specific calendar by ID
examples: Show me the details of this calendar
Get calendar information
What are the properties of this calendar?
notes: Returns calendar metadata including permissions (canEdit, canShare, canViewPrivateItems) and the owner information.

description: Create a new calendar
examples: Create a new calendar called Work Projects
Make a new calendar
Add a calendar for personal events
notes: Color values: auto, lightBlue, lightGreen, lightOrange, lightGray, lightYellow, lightTeal, lightPink, lightBrown, lightRed, maxColor. Returns the created calendar object.

description: List events in the user's default calendar
examples: Show me my upcoming events
List my calendar events
What meetings do I have?
Show my schedule
What's on my calendar?
notes: This endpoint does NOT expand recurring events into individual occurrences. Use /me/calendarView with startDateTime and endDateTime query params to correctly see recurring event instances. Filter by start/dateTime to avoid fetching old events.

description: List events in a specific (non-default) calendar
examples: Show me events in my Work calendar
List events from a specific calendar
What meetings are in my Team calendar?
notes: Replace {calendar_id} with the calendar's ID. To list events in a specific calendar, first use /me/calendars to find the calendar ID.

description: Get calendar view for a date range (correctly expands recurring events into individual occurrences)
examples: What's on my calendar this week?
Show me my meetings for today
What do I have scheduled next Monday?
List all events between March 1 and March 15
Show my calendar for tomorrow
notes: Use /me/calendarView with startDateTime and endDateTime query params -- this correctly expands recurring events into individual occurrences, unlike /me/events. Both startDateTime and endDateTime are REQUIRED. Dates must be ISO 8601 format. This is the preferred endpoint for 'what's on my calendar' type queries.

description: Get a single calendar event by ID with full details
examples: Show me the details of this event
Get the meeting information
Open this calendar event
What are the details of this meeting?
notes: Returns the full event including body content (HTML). The attendees array includes each person's responseStatus (none, organizer, tentativelyAccepted, accepted, declined). showAs values: free, tentative, busy, oof, workingElsewhere, unknown.

description: Search calendar events by subject or body content
examples: Search my calendar for budget review
Find meetings about project kickoff
Look for events mentioning quarterly planning
notes: Use $filter with contains() for subject search. The contains() function is case-insensitive. For broader search, you can also use $search but it is not supported on all calendar endpoints. Alternative: use /me/calendarView with $filter for date-scoped searches.

description: Create a basic calendar event with subject, start time, and end time
examples: Create a meeting tomorrow at 2pm
Schedule a new event
Add an event to my calendar
Book a meeting for Friday at 10am
Create a 1-hour meeting called Team Sync
notes: The dateTime value in start/end should NOT include a Z suffix when timeZone is specified. timeZone uses Windows time zone names (e.g., 'Eastern Standard Time', 'Pacific Standard Time', 'UTC'). If no timeZone is provided, UTC is assumed.

description: Create a calendar event and invite attendees
examples: Schedule a meeting with John and Sarah
Create an event and invite the team
Set up a meeting with attendees
Book a meeting and send invitations
notes: Attendee type values: 'required', 'optional', 'resource'. Meeting invitations are automatically sent to attendees when the event is created. The organizer is automatically added and does not need to be in the attendees list.

description: Create an all-day calendar event
examples: Create an all-day event for Friday
Add a full-day event to my calendar
Schedule an all-day out-of-office
Block off the whole day
notes: For all-day events, set isAllDay=true and use midnight-to-midnight times. The end date should be the NEXT day (e.g., Jan 15 to Jan 16 for a single all-day event on Jan 15). showAs values: 'free', 'tentative', 'busy', 'oof', 'workingElsewhere'.

description: Create a calendar event with an online Teams meeting link
examples: Create a Teams meeting
Schedule an online meeting
Set up a virtual meeting with a Teams link
Create a video call event
notes: Set isOnlineMeeting=true and onlineMeetingProvider='teamsForBusiness' to auto-generate a Teams meeting link. The onlineMeetingUrl will be populated in the response. Other provider options: 'teamsForBusiness', 'skypeForBusiness', 'skypeForConsumer'.

description: Create a recurring calendar event with a recurrence pattern
examples: Create a weekly team standup
Schedule a recurring meeting every Monday
Set up a daily check-in
Create a monthly review meeting
Schedule a biweekly sync
notes: Pattern type values: 'daily', 'weekly', 'absoluteMonthly', 'relativeMonthly', 'absoluteYearly', 'relativeYearly'. Range type values: 'endDate', 'noEnd', 'numbered' (numberOfOccurrences). For weekly patterns, daysOfWeek can include multiple days. The interval controls frequency (e.g., interval=2 for biweekly).

description: Update an existing calendar event
examples: Change the time of my meeting
Update the meeting subject
Reschedule this event
Move my meeting to 3pm
Add a location to this event
notes: Include only the fields you want to change. If attendees are present, updating the event sends update notifications. For recurring events, updating the series master updates all future occurrences.

description: Delete a calendar event
examples: Delete this meeting
Cancel and remove this event
Remove this from my calendar
Delete this calendar event
notes: Returns 204 No Content. If the event has attendees, cancellation notices are automatically sent. For recurring events, deleting the series master deletes all occurrences. To delete a single occurrence, use the occurrence ID.

description: Accept a calendar event invitation
examples: Accept this meeting invitation
RSVP yes to this event
Accept the invite
I'll attend this meeting
notes: Set sendResponse to true to notify the organizer of your acceptance. The comment is optional and included in the response to the organizer. Returns 202 Accepted.

description: Decline a calendar event invitation
examples: Decline this meeting invitation
RSVP no to this event
I can't attend this meeting
Decline the invite
notes: Set sendResponse to true to notify the organizer. The proposedNewTime is optional and suggests an alternative time when declining. Returns 202 Accepted.

description: Tentatively accept a calendar event invitation
examples: Tentatively accept this meeting
Mark this event as tentative
Maybe I'll attend this meeting
RSVP maybe to this event
notes: Set sendResponse to true to notify the organizer. The proposedNewTime is optional and suggests a preferred time. Returns 202 Accepted.

description: Cancel an event that you organized (sends cancellation to attendees)
examples: Cancel this meeting
Cancel the event and notify attendees
I need to cancel this meeting I organized
notes: Only the organizer can cancel an event. This sends cancellation notices to all attendees. The comment is included in the cancellation message. The event is then moved to the Deleted Items. If you are not the organizer, use DELETE instead to remove it from your calendar only.

description: Find available meeting times that work for all specified attendees
examples: Find a time to meet with John and Sarah
When are we all free for a meeting?
Suggest meeting times for the team
Find available slots for a 1-hour meeting
notes: meetingDuration uses ISO 8601 duration format (PT1H = 1 hour, PT30M = 30 min). activityDomain values: 'work', 'personal', 'unrestricted', 'unknown'. Set minimumAttendeePercentage to control how many attendees must be available (100 = all required). Returns meetingTimeSuggestions array ranked by confidence.

description: Get the free/busy schedule for one or more users
examples: Check if John is free at 2pm
Get the availability for these users
Show me Sarah's free/busy schedule
When is my manager available?
notes: schedules is an array of email addresses or user principal names. availabilityViewInterval is in minutes (15, 30, or 60). The response includes an availabilityView string where each character represents a time slot: 0=free, 1=tentative, 2=busy, 3=out of office, 4=working elsewhere. Also returns scheduleItems with details of each busy block.

description: List calendar reminders within a date range
examples: Show me my upcoming reminders
What reminders do I have this week?
List calendar reminders for today
Get my event reminders
notes: Replace {start} and {end} with ISO 8601 datetime strings. Returns events that have reminders firing within the specified window. Each result includes the event details and reminderFireTime. The reminderMinutesBeforeStart on each event controls when the reminder fires.

description: Get calendar view for a specific (non-default) calendar within a date range
examples: Show me this week's events in my Work calendar
What's on my Team calendar this month?
Get the calendar view for a specific calendar
notes: Same as /me/calendarView but scoped to a specific calendar by ID. Correctly expands recurring events. Both startDateTime and endDateTime are required.

description: Create an event in a specific (non-default) calendar
examples: Add an event to my Work calendar
Create a meeting in my Team calendar
Schedule an event on a specific calendar
notes: Creates the event in a specific calendar rather than the default. The calendar must be owned by or writable by the user (canEdit=true).

description: Add attendees to an existing calendar event
examples: Add John to this meeting
Invite more people to this event
Add an attendee to this calendar event
notes: The attendees array in the PATCH REPLACES all existing attendees. You must include all current attendees plus any new ones. First GET the event to retrieve existing attendees, then include them all in the PATCH. Update notifications are sent automatically.

description: Snooze a calendar event reminder
examples: Snooze this reminder
Remind me again in 10 minutes
Snooze the calendar reminder
notes: newReminderTime specifies when the reminder should fire again. Returns 200 OK with no body.

description: Dismiss a calendar event reminder
examples: Dismiss this reminder
Clear this calendar notification
I've seen this reminder, dismiss it
notes: Dismisses the reminder for this event occurrence. Returns 200 OK with no body. For recurring events, this only dismisses the reminder for the current occurrence.

description: List instances (occurrences) of a recurring event
examples: Show me all occurrences of this recurring meeting
List instances of this repeating event
When does this recurring event happen?
notes: Returns individual occurrences of a recurring event series within the specified date range. Both startDateTime and endDateTime are required. Each instance has its own ID that can be used for accepting, declining, or modifying that single occurrence.

description: Update the response status of an event (set show-as status)
examples: Set this meeting to show as tentative
Mark this event as out of office
Change my availability for this meeting to free
notes: showAs values: 'free', 'tentative', 'busy', 'oof' (out of office), 'workingElsewhere', 'unknown'. Use this to control how the time block appears on your calendar without sending a formal response to the organizer.

description: Delete a user-created calendar
examples: Delete this calendar
Remove my old project calendar
Get rid of this calendar
notes: Permanently deletes the calendar and all events within it. Returns 204 No Content. Cannot delete the default calendar. Only calendars the user owns can be deleted.

description: Update properties of an existing calendar (name, color)
examples: Rename my calendar to Team Meetings
Change the color of my Work calendar
Update the name of this calendar
notes: Color values: auto, lightBlue, lightGreen, lightOrange, lightGray, lightYellow, lightTeal, lightPink, lightBrown, lightRed, maxColor. Only include properties you want to change.

description: Set or change the reminder time on a calendar event
examples: Set a 15-minute reminder for this meeting
Change the reminder to 30 minutes before
Turn off the reminder for this event
notes: Set isReminderOn to false to disable the reminder entirely. Common reminderMinutesBeforeStart values: 0 (at time of event), 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 1440 (1 day), 10080 (1 week).

description: List attachments on a calendar event
examples: Show me the attachments on this event
What files are attached to this meeting?
List calendar event attachments
notes: Returns file attachments and reference attachments (cloud file links) on the event. The contentBytes field is base64-encoded and not included in list responses by default -- get a specific attachment by ID to retrieve the content.

description: Add a file attachment to a calendar event
examples: Attach a file to this meeting
Add an agenda document to the event
Upload an attachment to this calendar event
notes: contentBytes must be base64-encoded. Maximum attachment size for a single request is 3MB. For larger files, use an upload session. contentType is the MIME type (e.g., 'application/pdf').

description: Forward a calendar event invitation to another user
examples: Forward this meeting invite to John
Share this event with sarah@contoso.com
Forward the calendar invitation
notes: Forwards the event as a meeting invitation to the specified recipients. The comment is optional and included in the forwarded invitation message. Returns 202 Accepted with no body.
